title: Protected pair takes its third cluster; demo-tax-calculation-v2 completes Production
notes: Third of five clusters for the protected pair, thirty per cent. demo-tax-calculation-v2 reaches all five and its rollout is complete.
Targeting only, so the connection budget is untouched in the last days of the metered month.

This step exists because the plan previously jumped from 27 August straight to 1 September, which would have stalled the protected pair for a second time. Their rollout has to finish before any of the later clocks can start, so it gets its own cadence rather than riding along with the drain.
